title: Total conditional expectation work
statement: Let an input consist of a finite randomized constraint satisfaction problem with variables indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and a finite label set $D$. Its conditional expectation work is the sum, over all variables, of the work of the local conditional step at that variable.
